title: Vaishnavism Saints Chaitanya Mahaprabhu
definition: Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (1486–1534) was a 16th-century Bengali saint and social reformer who popularized Gaudiya Vaishnavism, emphasizing 'Bhakti' through 'Sankirtana' (congregational chanting) as the primary path to salvation.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the socio-religious evolution of Medieval India, the democratization of Bhakti, and the cultural synthesis in Bengal and Odisha.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Chaitanya Mahaprabhu.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
